synoptic_system: Central India Monsoon Depression Track & Heavy Rain Core

forecaster_guidance: SHIFT CORRIDOR: Correct forecast heavy rain swath 180 km southwards over North Telangana & South Chhattisgarh. Downscale local flood warnings accordingly.

forecaster_guidance: DELAY ONSET: Retard rain onset by 24 hours. Elevate freezing level to 2400m; downgrade plain snowfall alert to cold rain.
